drop_summary: ARTY closed at $69.58 on Fri 2026-10-16, 15.12% below its 2026-10-06 intraday high of $81.97 (14.35% below the $81.24 closing high), giving back that much in only 8 trading sessions. The drop tracks a broad AI-semiconductor rout (SOXX fell 16.30% over the same span vs QQQ -6.56%): doubts about AI monetization (a report that OpenAI's revenue run rate was ~$50B, not ~$70B, and Broadcom's CEO likening AI investing to a casino), credit stress at AI-infrastructure borrowers led by CoreWeave, a hotter-than-expected core CPI print that added to Fed-hike bets, and Chinese memory competition. The fund is still up 44.42% YTD on price; the move is a sharp pullback from a fresh high, not a long bear trend.

drivers.detail: Financial Times reported OpenAI's annualized revenue near $50B at end-September vs the ~$70B figure previously circulated; Nvidia fell 2.9%, Oracle nearly 6%, SpaceX 4%. ARTY fell 2.80% on 10/08 (calc).
drivers.source_title: OpenAI revenue gap report rattles AI stocks (Vermoegenszentrum, 9 Oct 2026)

drivers.detail: At a DBS conference in Singapore, Hock Tan said many AI investors don't understand what they own, compared the market to a casino, and flagged capital as AI's biggest constraint, while still seeing demand exceeding supply to ~2029-2030. ARTY fell 2.19% on 10/12 (calc).
drivers.source_title: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan likens many AI investors to casino gamblers (The Next Web)

drivers.driver: Chinese memory competition (CXMT) hits memory names
drivers.detail: CXMT reported progress on a denser 4F2 DRAM design; KOSPI fell nearly 5% on 10/13 with Samsung and SK Hynix each down ~5%, and Micron fell 3.9% in the prior US session. Micron (4.33% weight) fell 15.95% from 10/06 to 10/16 (calc).
drivers.source_title: KOSPI Drops 5% as China's CXMT Chip Advance Hits Samsung and SK Hynix (Mitrade)

drivers.detail: September core CPI rose 0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected (2.6% y/y vs 2.5%); S&P 500 IT sector fell 3.00%, Nasdaq -1.88%, and Barclays downgraded Dell/HPE/NetApp on AI-valuation grounds. ARTY fell 4.82% on 10/14, its worst day of the drop (calc).

drivers.driver: CoreWeave credit stress / AI-infrastructure financing fears
drivers.detail: CoreWeave shares fell ~15% on 10/14 and hit the lowest since May 2025 on 10/15; some bonds yielded >15% and CDS spreads topped 1,000bp. Oracle fell ~10% on 10/14, Nebius and Iren >10%. CRWV (3.66% weight) fell 33.07% from 10/06 to 10/16, the single largest approximate drag on ARTY (-1.21 pts, calc).
drivers.source_title: CoreWeave shares plunge to lowest since May 2025 as credit fears mount (ROIC.ai)

drivers.driver: TSMC beat but margin outlook disappointed
drivers.detail: TSMC Q3 net profit rose ~69% and it raised 2026 USD revenue growth guidance to ~44%, but guided Q4 gross margin to 65-67% (Q3 ~66%) and its US-listed shares slipped. TSM ADR fell 14.45% from 10/06 to 10/16 (calc).
drivers.source_title: ICYMI: TSMC profit jumps nearly 70% on AI demand, but margin outlook weighs on shares (InvestingLive)

drivers.driver: Friday chip rout resumes, rate-hike odds climb
drivers.detail: Nasdaq -2.15%, SOXX -4.14%, AMD -5.96%, Micron -5.63%, Broadcom -4.53%; VIX +22.5% to 20.16; CME odds of a December hike cited at 74.3% (from 50.2% a month earlier); Brent +3.7% to $109.86. Nasdaq's worst week since June. ARTY -4.50% on 10/16 (calc).
drivers.source_title: Nasdaq drops 2.1% as chip rout caps a 4.5% weekly slide (TS2)

drivers.detail: The Fed raised rates 25bp on 2026-09-16 to 3.75-4.00% (first hike since 2023) and the median dot (4.125%) implies further tightening, raising the discount rate on long-duration AI growth stocks.

bull_case.point: Core AI demand still growing fast
bull_case.evidence: TSMC (4.59% weight) reported Q3 revenue +50.9% y/y and net profit +68.7% y/y with a 66.4% gross margin; it also raised its 2026 USD growth outlook to ~44% from ~40% (per InvestingLive, 15 Oct 2026).
bull_case.source_title: TSMC Q3 (July-Sep) profit jumps 68.7% to USD 23.9 billion, revenue rises 50.9% (Times of Oman, 15 Oct 2026)

bull_case.point: Supply-constrained outlook from a top holding
bull_case.evidence: Broadcom's CEO forecast AI chip revenue rising from ~$58B this fiscal year to $230B in FY2028, and said compute demand exceeds supply possibly through 2029-2030.
bull_case.source_title: Broadcom CEO likens AI boom to a casino even as he targets $230 billion in chip sales (InvestingLive)

bull_case.evidence: Fund P/E fell from 41.87x (fact sheet, 2026-06-30) to 31.85x (iShares page, 2026-10-15), a 23.93% compression (calc), as earnings grew and prices pulled back.
bull_case.source_title: iShares ARTY fact sheet and product page

bull_case.point: Has recovered from a deeper drawdown this year
bull_case.evidence: Within the 52-week window ARTY fell 24.05% on a closing basis (2026-06-02 to 2026-07-29) and went on to set new highs by 2026-10-06 (calc on Robinhood daily bars); the current pullback (-14.35%) is smaller so far.

bull_case.point: Efficient, liquid wrapper with tight NAV tracking
bull_case.evidence: $3.71B net assets, 0.47% expense ratio, close at +0.021% premium to NAV on 10/16 (calc); 1y NAV return 85.56% vs benchmark 85.40% as of 6/30.
bull_case.source_title: iShares product page and fact sheet

bear_case.point: Concentrated in semiconductors and highly correlated with chip cycles
bear_case.evidence: 87.70% Information Technology (6/30 fact sheet); top-10 = 43.47% of assets (10/15, calc). From the high, ARTY fell 14.35% vs SOXX -16.30% and QQQ -6.56% (calc), so it behaves like a chip fund.
bear_case.source_title: iShares ARTY fact sheet; iShares holdings CSV

bear_case.evidence: CoreWeave spent $6.42B on property/equipment in Q2 vs $679M operating cash flow, carries ~$35.1B debt, and has bonds yielding >15%; CoreWeave and Oracle together are 7.64% of ARTY.
bear_case.source_title: CoreWeave shares plunge to lowest since May 2025 as credit fears mount (ROIC.ai)

bear_case.point: Monetization of AI spend is being questioned
bear_case.evidence: OpenAI's run-rate revenue reportedly near $50B vs ~$70B expected; Broadcom's CEO said most companies haven't found AI uses that pay off.
bear_case.source_title: OpenAI revenue gap report rattles AI stocks (Vermoegenszentrum)

bear_case.point: Rising-rate regime pressures long-duration growth multiples
bear_case.evidence: Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 with dots implying more; core CPI beat on 10/14; December hike odds cited at 74.3% on 10/16.
bear_case.source_title: MUFG September 2026 FOMC recap; TS2 market wrap 10/16

bear_case.evidence: CXMT's DRAM progress hit Samsung/SK Hynix ~5% on 10/13; 22 of 30 SOX members were >20% below their May/June highs as of 10/13 even before the latest leg down.
bear_case.source_title: AI fatigue drives chip stocks to their longest losing streak since May 2025 (Crypto Briefing)

data_gaps: AlphaVantage unavailable: TIME_SERIES_DAILY outputsize=full returned 'premium feature'; subsequent calls (GLOBAL_QUOTE, TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY, ETF_PROFILE) hit the free key's 25/day limit (shared across workers). Primary daily series is therefore Robinhood get_equity_historicals (split-adjusted, regular session), 2025-09-02 to 2026-10-16, 284 bars, no OHLC violations, no split detected.
AlphaVantage NEWS_SENTIMENT not used (quota). News drivers come from WebSearch/WebFetch.

Robinhood get_equity_quotes official-close field returned 2026-10-15 (72.86), not 2026-10-16; the 10/16 close of 69.58 is from the Robinhood daily bar and is corroborated by stockanalysis.com and the iShares NAV (69.5652).
iShares holdings CSV could not be downloaded directly (proxy 403 on www.ishares.com); top-15 weights were extracted through WebFetch's summarizer, not parsed line by line.
Holdings count disagrees: 50 (iShares page, 10/15), 49 (fact sheet, 6/30), 78 (stockanalysis.com, likely counts cash/FX lines).

Attribution covers 13 of the top 15 names (51.11% of assets); Global Unichip (3443 TW) and Naver (035420 KR) price moves not retrieved. TSMC move uses the US ADR as a proxy for the Taiwan line. Weights are 10/15 values applied to a 10/06-10/16 window, so contributions are approximate.

AUM disagrees >0.5% across sources: iShares $3.711B (10/16) vs Robinhood market_cap $3.754B (+1.15%) vs stockanalysis $3.88B (+4.55%); shares outstanding iShares 53.35M vs Robinhood 53.875M (+0.98%). iShares treated as authoritative.
P/E differs by source: iShares 31.85 (10/15) vs Robinhood pe_ratio 33.18.
Treasury-yield levels conflict across articles (10y quoted at 5.09%, 5.19% and 5.278% around 10/14-10/16); exact yields not used.
Hock Tan remark date: The Next Web says Monday 2026-10-12 (Singapore); a Crypto Briefing piece dates it 10/08. The Next Web date is used.
Fund flow (creation/redemption) data for the drop window not found.
Returns are price-only and exclude distributions; iShares-published total returns use different end dates (YTD NAV TR 51.37% to 10/15 vs calc YTD price return 51.22% to 10/15).
